tasks.label: wsl-android-build-install
tasks.command: ./gradlew assembleDebug && DEVICE=$(adb devices | grep -v 'List' | grep 'device$' | head -n 1 | awk '{print $1}') && if [ -z "$DEVICE" ]; then echo '❌ 錯誤：未找到任何正常的在線設備！'; exit 1; fi && echo "📱 正在安裝至設備: $DEVICE" && adb -s "$DEVICE" install -r -t app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk && adb -s "$DEVICE" shell am start -n com.nearby.justnow/.ui.main.MainActivity
